query:
UPDATE plex_server
                SET friendly_name = ?2,
                    platform      = ?4,
                    base_url      = ?5,
                    last_seen_at  = ?6,
                    last_version_change_at =
                        CASE WHEN version = ?3 THEN last_version_change_at ELSE ?6 END,
                    version       = ?3
              WHERE id = 1 AND machine_identifier = ?1
